references.text: In Matthew 22:21, Jesus says "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's", which relates to the payment in Matthew 17:27 to avoid causing offense.

Hebrews 13:17 urges obedience to leaders and submission to them, for they keep watch over your souls as those who will give an account. This can be viewed in light of not causing offense, as in Matthew 17:27.
